name: Open Source Engineering
audience: Junior through senior engineers building real open-source contribution and maintainership skill
philosophy: Contribute to real projects, get real feedback, and grow from a first pull request to maintainer judgment — every artifact is a real, externally-verifiable contribution, never a simulation of one.
aiPrinciples: AI assistance must be disclosed when materially used, especially on anything submitted to a real external project.
AI may explain, hint, and quiz, but must never author the code, prose, or review comments the apprentice submits under their own name to a real maintainer or contributor.
The apprentice remains accountable for every real pull request, issue comment, and review submitted under their own account.
Mentor approval is based on the real, externally-verifiable artifact — a PR, issue, or review URL — and the apprentice's ability to explain and defend it, not on how polished the submission looks.
